title: Challenging Tech Myths & Digital Ethics Op-Ed
goal: Challenge assumptions with negated dar por hecho/sentado que + subjunctive and read a C1 op-ed on AI accountability.

items: I can contrast affirmative *dar por hecho/sentado que* (+ indicative) with negated *no dar por sentado que* (+ subjunctive).
I can match the participle after *dar por* in gender and number with a direct noun (*dar por cerradas las dudas*).
I can follow an op-ed column on algorithmic bias, biometric surveillance, disinformation and democratic accountability.
